prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Nordic economic RTS interface icon atlas, one square image exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, no gaps. Each icon centered within its cell with generous 15% safe margin. Uniform solid dark charcoal brown background #211e18 across entire sheet, no frames, no text, no numbers, no lettering. Hand-painted high-quality remastered strategy game inventory illustrations: warm approachable Viking village craft, soft volumetric painted forms, clear chunky silhouettes readable at 48px, weathered oak, ivory, iron, muted moss green, russet red and blue cloth, restrained bronze. Soft upper-left light, no neon, no glowing magic, no modern line icons, no horned helmets. Exactly one illustration per cell in this exact row-major order:
Row 1: wooden mallet crossed with a small timber carpenter square (construction); two friendly Nordic villager busts woman and man (population); leather work glove holding small wooden gear (assistant); wooden tally board with pebbles and counting sticks (statistics).
Row 2: rolled parchment with red wax seal (mission); two small round wooden shields overlapping with olive branch (diplomacy); open weathered leather-bound book (knowledge); bread loaf with wheat and apple (food).
Row 3: three timber logs and two grey stones (materials); iron short sword over round red wooden shield (armament); leather satchel and small iron hand tool (equipment); wooden goods crate with folded cloth (other).
Row 4: friendly red-bearded Nordic woodcutter portrait chest-up moss tunic (notification portrait); blonde Nordic woman portrait chest-up blue wool dress (population); brown-haired child portrait chest-up russet tunic (population); small carpenter workbench with timber planks and axe (construction illustration).
All sixteen separate icons have consistent painting, object scale, background and lighting. Original new designs, not copied game assets. No UI windows, no borders, no labels. Square 4x4 atlas.
export: Byte-for-byte copy. CSS background-size 400% 400%; 4x4 row-major cells, no raster edits.
